card.name: Words just before 'early' or 'first'
card.fires_on: Small words such as its, those, the, of, or a full stop, in history or background text where the next word is likely 'early' or 'earliest' (early residents, early studies, early designs).

modes.label: Determiner before early
modes.description: A word like its, those or the sits right before an expected 'early' describing first settlers or first studies.
modes.example: The township of Thetford was named by one of<< its>> early resident, Nahum N. Wilson

modes.label: Sentence start about origins
modes.description: A full stop or linking word that leads into a sentence about early development or original designs.
modes.example: Early designs of a re-usable space vehicle bore little resemblance to The Space Shuttle.<< One>> concept had what looked like two airplanes stacked
